name: A Late Night Convo
source:
Unable to sleep, Seo-jun talks to his partner Iris about their relationship and how much he appreciates her.

[From [url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/a-late-night-convo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
难以入睡的Seo-jun与伴侣艾瑞丝谈起了两人的关系，也告诉她，自己有多么珍惜她。
